title: event.get
description: Retrieve events according to the given parameters.

eventids.description: Return only events with the given IDs.

groupids.description: Return only events created by objects that belong to the given host groups.

hostids.description: Return only events created by objects that belong to the given hosts.

objectids.description: Return only events created by the given objects.

source.description: Return only events with the given type. Refer to the event object page for a list of supported event types. Possible values: 0 - event created by a trigger; 1 - event created by a discovery rule; 2 - event created by active agent autoregistration; 3 - internal event; 4 - event created on service status update. Default: 0 - trigger events.

object.description: Return only events created by objects of the given type. Refer to the event object page for a list of supported object types. Possible values for trigger events: 0 - trigger. Possible values for discovery events: 1 - discovered host; 2 - discovered service. Possible values for autoregistration events: 3 - auto-registered host. Possible values for internal events: 0 - trigger; 4 - item; 5 - LLD rule. Possible values for service events: 6 - service. Default: 0 - trigger.

acknowledged.description: If set to true return only acknowledged events.

suppressed.description: If set to true return only suppressed events.

severities.description: Return only events with given event severities. Applies only if object is trigger. Possible values: 0 - not classified; 1 - information; 2 - warning; 3 - average; 4 - high; 5 - disaster.

evaltype.description: Rules for tag searching. Possible values: 0 - (default) And/Or; 2 - Or.

tags.description: Return only events with given tags. Exact match by tag and case-insensitive search by value and operator. Format: [{"tag": "", "value": "", "operator": ""}, ...]. An empty array returns all events.

operator.description: Possible operator types: 0 - (default) Like; 1 - Equal; 2 - Not like; 3 - Not equal; 4 - Exists; 5 - Not exists.

eventid_from.description: Return only events with IDs greater or equal to the given ID.

eventid_till.description: Return only events with IDs less or equal to the given ID.

time_from.description: Return only events that have been created after or at the given time.

time_till.description: Return only events that have been created before or at the given time.

problem_time_from.description: Returns only events that were in the problem state starting with problem_time_from. Applies only if the source is trigger event and object is trigger. Mandatory if problem_time_till is specified.

problem_time_till.description: Returns only events that were in the problem state until problem_time_till. Applies only if the source is trigger event and object is trigger. Mandatory if problem_time_from is specified.

value.description: Return only events with the given values. Possible values for trigger and service events: 0 - OK; 1 - problem. Possible values for discovery events: 0 - host or service up; 1 - host or service down; 2 - host or service discovered; 3 - host or service lost. Possible values for internal events: 0 - "normal" state; 1 - "unknown" or "not supported" state. This parameter is not used for active agent autoregistration events.

selectHosts.description: Return a hosts property with hosts containing the object that created the event. Supported only for events generated by triggers, items or LLD rules.

selectRelatedObject.description: Return a relatedObject property with the object that created the event. The type of object returned depends on the event type.

select_alerts.description: Return an alerts property with alerts generated by the event. Alerts are sorted in reverse chronological order.

select_acknowledges.description: Return an acknowledges property with event updates. Event updates are sorted in reverse chronological order. The event update object has the following properties: acknowledgeid - (string) acknowledgment's ID; userid - (string) ID of the user that updated the event; eventid - (string) ID of the updated event; clock - (timestamp) time when the event was updated; message - (string) text of the message; action - (integer) update action that was performed, see event.acknowledge; old_severity - (integer) event severity before this update action; new_severity - (integer) event severity after this update action; username - (string) username of the user that updated the event; name - (string) name of the user that updated the event; surname - (string) surname of the user that updated the event. Supports count.

selectTags.description: Return a tags property with event tags.

selectSuppressionData.description: Return a suppression_data property with the list of maintenances: maintenanceid - (string) ID of the maintenance; suppress_until - (integer) time until the event is suppressed.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values are: eventid, objectid and clock.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
